report_evidence.example_masked: The file is a FULL-YEAR return, evidently tax year 2025: pension records carry exactly 14 x the December-2025 monthly pension of the Accumulated Report (12 mesadas + 2 additional), the pensioner EPS-offset amounts are exactly 12 x December 2025, every amount is >= the Oct-Dec 2025 months of the same wage types, and the records appear in the same identity order as the client's Form 220 working file for 2025-01-01..2025-12-31.

fields.finding: The file is a full-year 2025 return (12 mesadas + 2 additional mesadas on pensioners, 12 x December on the EPS offset, same identity order as the client's 2025 Form 220 working file), so the spec's calendar-year rule is what the client applies. The annex shows how the year is carried in the XML header and the spec does not: the header attribute 'Ano' is the YEAR OF SENDING (año de envío - the same aaaa as the file name), while the tax year reported is carried by FecInicial / FecFinal (the first and last date to which the records correspond, AAAA-MM-DD). A developer reading 'Ano' as the tax year would be one year out.
fields.proposed_explanation: Append to the Field Explanation: 'In the XML header (element Cab, Anexo T3.45) the tax year is carried by FecInicial and FecFinal - the first and last day of the tax year reported, format AAAA-MM-DD - while the header attribute Ano is the YEAR OF SENDING (año de envío, the same aaaa as in the file name), not the tax year: for the 2026 return filed in 2027, Ano = 2027, FecInicial = 2026-01-01 and FecFinal = 2026-12-31.'
